features: Thermal smart linkage tracking system: bi-spectrum panoramic bullet camera plus optical PTZ speed dome with auto-tracking
thermal module: 384x288 VOx uncooled, 17 um pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <= 35 mK, thermal FOV 10.7 x 8.0, digital zoom x2/x4/x8
optical bullet channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), 14.8 mm lens, 120 dB WDR
optical PTZ dome: 1/1.8in 2688x1520, 6-252 mm 42x optical zoom, 16x digital zoom, 140 dB WDR, IR up to 400 m
temperature measurement -20 to 150 C, accuracy +/-8 C, 3 rule types (21 rules: 10 points, 10 areas, 1 line)
dynamic fire detection, up to 10 fire points
multi-target tracking up to 30 targets, intrusion and line-crossing detection
pan/tilt speed dome: pan 360, tilt -20 to 90, auto flip; universal joint module pan 90, tilt -45 to 45
line-level audio in/out, alarm in/out, RS-485
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TX3742-35P is a thermal smart linkage tracking system pairing a 384x288 bi-spectrum bullet camera (35 mm thermal, 4 MP optical) with a 42x optical PTZ speed dome that auto-tracks moving targets. It measures temperature (-20 to 150 C) and performs fire and perimeter detection for long-range perimeter protection.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal + optical exposed as separate channels; optical PTZ dome is separately addressable.
